component.name: Slacky
component.summary: Slack client for Linux arm64 systems

description.p: Slacky is a desktop Slack client for Linux machines running on arm64 hardware, where the official Slack desktop app is not available. It wraps the Slack web client in a native window so it behaves like a normal desktop application.

ul.li: Sign in to several Slack workspaces and switch between them
Desktop notifications that focus the window when clicked
Google single sign-on completed inside the app
slack:// deep links open in Slacky rather than a browser

screenshot.caption: The Slack workspace running in Slacky

description.p: First stable release: multiple workspaces, native huddle pop-out windows, in-app Google SSO, window focus on notification click, and arm64 AppImage, deb and rpm packages.
